risk_description: Inventory discrepancies discovered during cutover could delay go-live by 2 weeks
business_impact: Unable to process receipts/shipments during parallel run period
mitigation_steps: Completed inventory audit with 98.5% accuracy; parallel run in progress; rollback plan ready; comms team briefed

risk_description: Data migration validation incomplete - risk of corrupted master records in new system
business_impact: Could discover critical data issues post-cutover requiring emergency fixes and manual intervention
mitigation_steps: Incremental testing plan; parallel run for 1 week; data reconciliation daily; SQL backup verification

risk_description: New network paths not fully tested under peak load - risk of routing congestion at cutover
business_impact: Could cause service interruption affecting customer deliveries during peak retail period
mitigation_steps: Load testing at 150% peak traffic; alternate routing configured; 24/7 monitoring staffed; vendor on standby

risk_description: Payment gateway switchover timing not synchronized - potential transaction failures during cutover
business_impact: Customers unable to complete orders during switchover window (estimated 2-4 hours)
mitigation_steps: Dual payment gateway testing done; 24/7 support standing by; customer comms prepared; rollback tested

risk_description: Big bang cutover weekend leaves no rollback once old DC stock has moved
business_impact: A failed go-live during peak would strand store and online replenishment
mitigation_steps: Go/no-go gate 72 hours before cutover; keep old DC stock records frozen not decommissioned for 2 weeks; named rollback owner

risk_description: Last phased wave lands inside the peak freeze
business_impact: Final wave overlaps Black Friday volumes with an unstable new DC
mitigation_steps: Pull wave three forward ahead of the freeze; hold a go/no-go gate before each wave; agree freeze exception with trading

risk_description: Parallel run needs double staffing through peak
business_impact: Labour shortfall could degrade service at both old and new DC
mitigation_steps: Pre-book agency labour for both sites; cap parallel run to the top 30% of volume lines

business_impact: WMS interface and inventory reconciliation may not revert cleanly within the 4 hour window
mitigation_steps: Rehearse rollback in a dress rehearsal; reconcile stock after each wave; keep old DC WMS interfaces live
